propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC only, off by default) returns 429 responses that are not retried by the current transport, causing failures on rate-limited requests
The retry logic must honor the Retry-After response header when present, apply up to 20% jitter, and clamp to MAX_BACKOFF_S, degrading gracefully when the header is absent

Rate-limit retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in (defaulting OFF) to prevent duplicate mutations, requiring two distinct code paths: through _call_logged for paged searches and direct _with_connection_retry calls for per-issue fetches
The 429 exception must escape as BackendHTTPError with code 429 across the adapter boundary, never as the raw JIRAError vendor type

Four specific read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map paged search, get_comment_map per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must opt into rate-limit retry by passing True, while all mutation call sites must remain non-retrying
The rate_limit_retry parameter must default to False on _with_connection_retry, _call_logged, and _paged_search to prevent silent retry inheritance by future callers
